description: This file defines the HorizontalStackedYAxisRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering the Y axis of stacked bar charts (specifically of type BarStacked2D) in the PDFsharp.Charting library. It contains logic for calculating the minimum and maximum Y axis bounds based on stacked bar series data.

classes.name: HorizontalStackedYAxisRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for the Y axis of Horizontal Stacked Bar charts of type BarStacked2D.

methods.name: HorizontalStackedYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with specified parameters.

methods.name: CalcYAxis
methods.description: Calculates the Y axis bounds by summing positive and negative stacked values across all series at each point index.
